flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi: NotificationSmsEmailJob + NotificationSmsEmailHelper (RD1 reminder candidates, combineNotices, template RD1_SMS_INDIVIDUAL, sendBatchSms, contact refresh), SmsUtil (sms.enable and sms.allowedSources gate), FurnishApprovalHelper (hirer number from the furnish form), application-{dev,uat,prod}.properties and cron-schedules-prod.properties. Other repos: no relevant code. Only ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java is cited (the cronservice/ folder at the repo root is an old copy and is not used)
note: Status in stories.json: Demo paid (50% of 75%); demo_remark about Vault, SMS and the SMS permission for the App Service. This is the hirer version of OCMS11.9 (owner): the SMS flow for individuals after the 1st letter exists and does not distinguish owner and hirer. Candidates are stage RD1, notices of the same recipient are combined per stage and due date, the template is picked from the name RD1_SMS_INDIVIDUAL (or _COMBINED), then sent in batches through APIM Postman2 (SmsUtil). Blockers in the repo configuration: (1) cron.notification.enabled=false in all environments (manual trigger only); (2) sms.enable=false in dev/uat/prod and sms.allowedSources=ENOTIFICATION only in dev/uat, not in prod, so in prod SmsUtil refuses to send; (3) the number refresh from DataHive is off (cron.enareminder.datahive=false), so the hirer number comes from the owner's furnish form. The SMS template text lives in ocms_template_store (DB): cannot verify from repo. Tickets as hints: OCMS-DF-2026-180 (Closed, waiting for the eNotification cron to be activated). Property values per environment in Azure, the APIM/Postman2 service, DOS, and the SMS permission of the App Service: cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Partial claim: the RD1 SMS flow exists, but in the prod properties SMS and the eNotification cron are off and the template text cannot be verified from the repo

steps.step: OCMS gets the latest mobile number of the individual hirer from the data source (DOS)
steps.detail: Individuals are looked up in DataHive Singpass (refreshIndividualContactInfo, NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2710-2760) and the new number is saved, called from NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:185-188. But refreshContactInfo only runs when cron.enareminder.datahive = 'true' (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2461-2485) and that property is false in dev/uat/prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:48), so the number stored in ocms_offence_notice_owner_driver is used. For a hirer, that number is the phone typed by the owner in the furnish form (FurnishApprovalHelper.java:552-558). Whether DataHive = 'DOS' in the story and the Vault permission (demo_remark): cannot verify from repo. Same as OCMS11.9 step 1.

steps.step: OCMS identifies the unique individual hirers and combines their outstanding NOPOs into one SMS
steps.detail: combineNotices groups notices by recipient key (I_<id_no> for individuals) + stage + due date, sums amount_payable and fills combinedNotices (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2151-2227; getRecipientKey 2230-2250; called at NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:191). Companies are kept out of the SMS batch (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:268-285). Partial because the key includes the due date, so the same hirer with notices on different due dates receives more than one SMS, and the job comment says 'no deduplication by phone', so two hirers with the same number are each sent a message. Same as OCMS11.9 step 2.

steps.step: Hirers who opted out, hold a passport, or have no valid mobile do not get an SMS
steps.detail: Exclusion-list and passport records are removed before the SMS batch is built (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:226-241); records without phoneNo or with a contactError are skipped through validateContactInfo (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:254-266; NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2259-2290). Same as OCMS11.9 step 3.

steps.step: The SMS lists the outstanding NOPOs and refers to the 1st letter reminder
steps.detail: For reminders, nextProcessingStage is filled with the last stage (RD1) (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:174-180) so determineTemplateName yields RD1_SMS_INDIVIDUAL or RD1_SMS_INDIVIDUAL_COMBINED (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:443-476). The template data carries noticeNo, combinedNotices, noticeCount, amountPayable and paymentDueDate (410-437); the due date is computed from last_processing_date + POS + PDD, same as the letter (1076-1100). The template text lives in ocms_template_store (DB), so whether it mentions the 1st letter reminder and lists the NOPOs: cannot verify from repo; if the template is missing, the SMS is skipped (274-345). Same as OCMS11.9 step 4.

steps.step: The SMS is sent to the individual hirers in a batch job
steps.detail: sendBatchSms validates the content (GSM-7), builds batches of at most 1000 (prod) and calls smsUtil.sendBatchSmsSimple with source ENOTIFICATION (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1527-1625), called from NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:289-292. SmsUtil refuses to send when sms.enable=false unless the source is in sms.allowedSources (SmsUtil.java:38-44, 401-410). sms.enable=false in prod, uat and dev; sms.allowedSources=ENOTIFICATION only in uat (application-uat.properties:80-82) and dev (application-dev.properties:83-85), not in prod (application-prod.properties:87). Plus cron.notification.enabled=false (cron-schedules-prod.properties:236). So under the prod configuration in the repo, the SMS to the hirer is not sent. The actual delivery through APIM Postman2 and the SMS permission for the App Service: cannot verify from repo. Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-180 (Closed): the eNotification cron is waiting to be activated. Same as OCMS11.9 step 5.
